column3: With respect to the Spokane Retail Portfolio Mortgage Loan (2.4%), for the Sullivan Retail Center property, having an allocated loan amount of $2,570,528 or 12.4% of the Mortgage Loan amount, the Phase I environmental site assessment identified an REC related to prior orchard use and related pesticide contamination risks. Because the site is capped by a building slab and asphalt paving, the environmental consultant recommended no further action other than avoiding soil disturbance. The Mortgage Loan documents include related compliance covenants.
